items.text: Laurus Labs Limited has informed the Exchange about the Outcome of Board Meeting held on 14-Nov-2026. The Board approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations of Rs. 1,412.6 crore, up 21.4% YoY. EBITDA of Rs. 318.2 crore, up 48% YoY with EBITDA margin at 22.5%. Net profit of Rs. 128.4 crore against Rs. 41.3 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous year.

Avanti Feeds Limited has submitted to the Exchange the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations Rs. 1,502.3 crore (previous year Rs. 1,391.0 crore). Profit after tax Rs. 171.5 crore, up 32.6% YoY. The Board also declared an interim dividend of Rs. 6.50 per equity share of face value Re. 1 each.

Outcome of Board Meeting: the Board at its meeting held today approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations Rs. 218.4 crore, down 9.8% YoY. The Company reported a net loss of Rs. 4.2 crore for the quarter against a net profit of Rs. 11.6 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous year, on account of lower realisations in the Thailand operations and a one-time inventory write-down.

Press release for the financial results for Q2 FY27. Revenue from operations grew 17.2% YoY to Rs. 1,106.9 crore. EBITDA at Rs. 212.4 crore, EBITDA margin 19.2% against 14.1% a year ago. Profit after tax Rs. 134.7 crore, up 61.3% YoY. Management commentary: demand in Europe and NAFTA regions remained strong; the Company maintains its revenue growth guidance of 15-18% for FY27.

Granules India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Outcome of Board Meeting held on 13-Nov-2026 approving the unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations Rs. 1,041.2 crore, down 14.6% YoY. Profit after tax Rs. 38.9 crore against Rs. 105.4 crore in Q2 FY26, down 63.1% YoY, impacted by the remediation at the Gagillapur facility following the US FDA inspection and lower volumes in the API segment.

Integrated filing (financial) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations Rs. 2,780.4 crore, up 19.6% YoY. EBITDA Rs. 286.3 crore, EBITDA margin 10.3%. Net profit Rs. 191.2 crore, up 21.8% YoY. Order book as of September 30, 2026 stood at Rs. 3,920 crore. The new Sanand facility commenced trial production during the quarter.

The Board of Directors at its meeting held today approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Income from operations Rs. 174.2 crore, down 24.5% YoY. Net profit Rs. 12.1 crore against Rs. 69.4 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous year, down 82.6%. The decline reflects the continued impact of the GST demand on gross gaming revenue and lower footfalls at the Goa properties.

Poly Medicure Limited informs that the Board of Directors at its meeting held today has approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations Rs. 428.6 crore, up 18.9% YoY. Profit after tax Rs. 92.3 crore, up 24.1% YoY. The Board also approved capex of Rs. 150 crore for a new plant in Jaipur.

Disclosure under Regulation 31(1) and 31(2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011: Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Limited informs that the promoter group entity Saldanha Family Trust has created a pledge on 1,25,00,000 equity shares (4.43% of the total share capital) in favour of a lender on 12-Nov-2026. Total encumbered shares of the promoter group after this event: 2,80,00,000 shares, 9.92% of the total share capital.

Disclosure of encumbered shares under Regulation 31 of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011. Jubilant Pharmova Limited informs that the promoter entity Jubilant Enpro Pvt Ltd has released the pledge on 42,00,000 equity shares (2.64% of the share capital) on 10-Nov-2026. Encumbered shares of the promoter group after the release: nil.

Suzlon Energy Limited informs the Exchange that pursuant to Regulation 31 of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011, the promoter Tanti Holdings Private Limited has created an additional pledge of 5,40,00,000 equity shares (0.40% of the paid-up capital) with a lender towards a loan facility. The aggregate encumbrance of the promoter group now stands at 6.12% of the paid-up share capital.

Disclosure under Regulation 31(2): the lender has invoked the pledge on 60,00,000 equity shares (1.52% of the total share capital) of Reliance Infrastructure Limited held by the promoter entity on 11-Nov-2026 against the outstanding dues of the borrower. Encumbered shares after the invocation: 4,10,00,000, 10.38% of the total share capital.

JSW Energy Limited informs that the promoter entity JSW Investments Pvt Ltd has pledged 2,10,00,000 equity shares (1.20% of the share capital) in favour of a lender in connection with a refinancing facility, taking the total encumbrance of the promoter group to 2.66% of the paid-up share capital, as per the disclosure under Regulation 31 of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011.

KPI Green Energy Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has received a Letter of Award from a leading corporate for the development of a 120 MW solar power project under the captive power producer segment. The order is valued at approximately Rs. 548.9 crore and is to be executed within 15 months from the date of the award.

H.G. Infra Engineering Limited has been declared L1 bidder by the National Highways Authority of India for the project 'Construction of 6-lane access-controlled greenfield highway from km 112 to km 148 of NH-148N in the state of Rajasthan' on Hybrid Annuity Mode. The bid project cost is Rs. 1,147.5 crore with a construction period of 24 months.

Titagarh Rail Systems Limited informs that it has received an order from Indian Railways for the manufacture and supply of 500 BOXNS wagons valued at Rs. 212.6 crore. The order is to be executed over a period of 12 months.

PNC Infratech Limited has received a Letter of Acceptance from the Madhya Pradesh Road Development Corporation for the project 'Rehabilitation and upgradation of the Sagar-Damoh section of State Highway 15 to two lanes with paved shoulders' at a bid price of Rs. 686.3 crore, to be completed in 30 months.

items.category: Action(s) taken or orders passed by any regulatory, statutory, enforcement authority or judicial body
items.text: Brightcom Group Limited informs that the Securities and Exchange Board of India has passed a final order dated 12-Nov-2026 in the matter of the Company, restraining the Chairman and Managing Director and the Chief Financial Officer from holding the position of a director or key managerial personnel in any listed company for a period of two years and directing the Company to restate its financial statements for FY2020 to FY2023.

items.category: Action(s) taken or orders passed by any regulatory, statutory, enforcement authority or judicial body
items.text: Religare Enterprises Limited informs the Exchange that the Hon'ble Delhi High Court by its order dated 11-Nov-2026 has dismissed the petition filed against the Company and its directors, holding that the allegations were without merit. The order is in favour of the Company; no financial impact arises.

Gensol Engineering Limited informs that the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Ahmedabad Bench, has admitted the application filed by a financial creditor under Section 7 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 and initiated the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process against the Company by its order dated 13-Nov-2026. An Interim Resolution Professional has been appointed and the powers of the Board stand suspended.

Vedanta Limited informs that CRISIL Ratings has downgraded the long-term rating on the Company's bank facilities and non-convertible debentures from CRISIL AA to CRISIL AA- with a negative outlook, citing the elevated leverage at the parent and the refinancing requirements over the next twelve months. The short-term rating is reaffirmed at CRISIL A1+.

JK Paper Limited informs that India Ratings and Research has upgraded the Company's long-term issuer rating to IND AA+ from IND AA with a stable outlook, reflecting the sustained improvement in the operating performance, the deleveraging over FY25-FY26 and the strong liquidity position.

Spandana Sphoorty Financial Limited informs that ICRA has revised the rating on the Company's non-convertible debentures and long-term bank facilities to [ICRA]A- from [ICRA]A, and placed the rating on watch with negative implications, on account of the sharp deterioration in asset quality and the losses reported in the first half of FY27.

Paisalo Digital Limited informs that the statutory auditors of the Company have tendered their resignation with effect from 12-Nov-2026, citing pre-occupation with other assignments. The auditors have confirmed in their letter under Regulation 30 that there are no other material reasons for the resignation. The Board will appoint new statutory auditors in due course.

Tata Elxsi Limited informs that the Board of Directors at its meeting held today has approved the appointment of Mr. Manoj Raghavan as Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of the Company for a further term of five years with effect from 01-Jan-2027, subject to the approval of the shareholders.

Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited informs that Mr. Punit Goenka has resigned from the position of Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer with effect from the close of business hours on 14-Nov-2026, to pursue other interests. The Board has constituted a committee to identify a successor; in the interim, the Chief Operating Officer will oversee the day-to-day operations.

Aether Industries Limited informs that the Board of Directors at its meeting held today has approved the acquisition of 100% of the equity share capital of a speciality chemicals company based in Gujarat for a total consideration of Rs. 112.5 crore in cash, to be funded from internal accruals. The acquisition adds a fluorination platform and is expected to be completed within 90 days.

IndiaMART InterMESH Limited informs that the Board of Directors at its meeting held today has approved a buyback of up to 20,00,000 fully paid-up equity shares of face value Rs. 10 each at a price of Rs. 3,100 per share, for an aggregate amount of up to Rs. 620 crore, through the tender offer route. The buyback represents 3.33% of the total paid-up equity share capital.

Cupid Limited informs the Exchange about the schedule of the earnings conference call for analysts and institutional investors to discuss the financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The call will be held on 17-Nov-2026 at 11:00 AM IST; the dial-in details are enclosed.

Pursuant to the Code of Conduct to regulate, monitor and report trading by Designated Persons under the SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015, the trading window for dealing in the securities of the Company shall remain closed for all Designated Persons from 01-Jan-2027 till 48 hours after the declaration of the financial results for the quarter ending December 31, 2026.
